title: Field Training
summary: Learn to command before Rome comes looking for you: select and move troops, drive off a scouting party, put builders to work on timber, stone and ore, raise a Home, recruit an army, break a Roman raid, and take the enemy camp.
teaching_goal: Every system a first match asks for, in the order a new commander meets them: selection and orders, the resource loop from tree to yard, construction cost and placement, recruitment and the population that limits it, stances, the commander's aura and rally, camera, speed and objectives - then one small assault to put it all together.
narrative_intent: A guided first field, paced by the player rather than the clock: the Roman raid waits until the recruit's army stands, and the enemy camp is small enough to fall to a first attack.

victory_conditions.description: Kill the Roman commander and take the outpost. A nation dies with the man who leads it.

defeat_conditions.description: Your commander falls - and every line collapses behind him.
A general alone on a dead field is just the last corpse standing.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: A new standard in the valley, and nobody under it who has held a spear more than twice. My outpost has orders to go and look at you. Try to still be standing when they arrive; it makes the report worth writing.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: The scouts are not coming back, then. Well - everyone begins somewhere, and you have begun by killing eleven men who were expecting their lunch. Rome will send someone who counts next time.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_field_commander
commander_messages.text: A camp, and nobody left standing in it. Get up. There is no shame in it. The shame would be in doing it a second time in the same valley.

theme: Learn the trade of war before Rome comes looking for you.
